meta.title: Absorbing Recollections
meta.description: She is bound by the memories that belong to her. She can scent the fragrance of the past, but not see into it.

units.rawText: There it is... Professor, we've caught up!
units.displayText: There it is... Professor, we've caught up!

spans.text: There it is... Professor, we've caught up!

units.rawText: Theoretically, that would be impossible. However, in this place, common sense might well be the first thing you ought to discard.
units.displayText: Theoretically, that would be impossible. However, in this place, common sense might well be the first thing you ought to discard.

spans.text: Theoretically, that would be impossible. However, in this place, common sense might well be the first thing you ought to discard.

units.rawText: This is truly unbelievable... we chased after a comet and successfully hovered on top of it!
units.displayText: This is truly unbelievable... we chased after a comet and successfully hovered on top of it!

spans.text: This is truly unbelievable... we chased after a comet and successfully hovered on top of it!

units.rawText: Hehe... I did not think it was possible either. When the Professor suggested it, I was as surprised as you.
units.displayText: Hehe... I did not think it was possible either. When the Professor suggested it, I was as surprised as you.

spans.text: Hehe... I did not think it was possible either. When the Professor suggested it, I was as surprised as you.

units.rawText: This is not the real world, after all... if Hubble wills it, chances are it'd be harder to find something we can't do.
units.displayText: This is not the real world, after all... if Hubble wills it, chances are it'd be harder to find something we can't do.

spans.text: This is not the real world, after all... if Hubble wills it, chances are it'd be harder to find something we can't do.

units.rawText: If the alien star's influence was to proliferate, and starlight to coalesce more, perhaps that will be true.
units.displayText: If the alien star's influence was to proliferate, and starlight to coalesce more, perhaps that will be true.

spans.text: If the alien star's influence was to proliferate, and starlight to coalesce more, perhaps that will be true.

units.rawText: I do hope that is true. We haven't caught sight of your Entropic Core yet... but this progress could certainly be worse.
units.displayText: I do hope that is true. We haven't caught sight of your Entropic Core yet... but this progress could certainly be worse.

spans.text: I do hope that is true. We haven't caught sight of your Entropic Core yet... but this progress could certainly be worse.

units.rawText: Besides, we have the help of the Sector's Administrator, Xuannu. If the signals are true, there are Entropized Agents here too, yes?
units.displayText: Besides, we have the help of the Sector's Administrator, Xuannu. If the signals are true, there are Entropized Agents here too, yes?

spans.text: Besides, we have the help of the Sector's Administrator, Xuannu. If the signals are true, there are Entropized Agents here too, yes?

units.rawText: ...Correct, but the situation is different. A comet's structure is quite different.
units.displayText: ...Correct, but the situation is different. A comet's structure is quite different.

spans.text: ...Correct, but the situation is different. A comet's structure is quite different.

units.rawText: With the interference of the comet's tail, it is difficult for us to observe their exact positions. It would be better for you to prioritize locating the memory data.
units.displayText: With the interference of the comet's tail, it is difficult for us to observe their exact positions. It would be better for you to prioritize locating the memory data.

spans.text: With the interference of the comet's tail, it is difficult for us to observe their exact positions. It would be better for you to prioritize locating the memory data.

units.rawText: We've collected some scraps on the way here, but it's far from enough.
units.displayText: We've collected some scraps on the way here, but it's far from enough.

spans.text: We've collected some scraps on the way here, but it's far from enough.

units.rawText: The surface of the comet's core bears a very complete set of memory data, likely a segment very important to Hubble.
units.displayText: The surface of the comet's core bears a very complete set of memory data, likely a segment very important to Hubble.

spans.text: The surface of the comet's core bears a very complete set of memory data, likely a segment very important to Hubble.

units.rawText: Entropization is still ticking away. Protect it well.
units.displayText: Entropization is still ticking away. Protect it well.

spans.text: Entropization is still ticking away. Protect it well.

units.rawText: We will!
units.displayText: We will!

spans.text: We will!

units.rawText: You sure are enthusiastic, Fresnel.
units.displayText: You sure are enthusiastic, Fresnel.

spans.text: You sure are enthusiastic, Fresnel.

units.rawText: It is not often that we get to see such splendid sights... shall we?
units.displayText: It is not often that we get to see such splendid sights... shall we?

spans.text: It is not often that we get to see such splendid sights... shall we?

units.rawText: Hubble grabs Fresnel's hand, descending from the spaceship as if going on a leisurely stroll.
units.displayText: Hubble grabs Fresnel's hand, descending from the spaceship as if going on a leisurely stroll.

spans.text: Hubble grabs Fresnel's hand, descending from the spaceship as if going on a leisurely stroll.

units.rawText: No support, no tether, no instruments, quietly drifting through space, till they are submerged in the comet's hazy light—
units.displayText: No support, no tether, no instruments, quietly drifting through space, till they are submerged in the comet's hazy light—

spans.text: No support, no tether, no instruments, quietly drifting through space, till they are submerged in the comet's hazy light—

units.rawText: Wait! This is...
units.displayText: Wait! This is...

spans.text: Wait! This is...

units.rawText: These responses... Professor, hold on! You're going to be sucked in by the materialized memory data!
units.displayText: These responses... Professor, hold on! You're going to be sucked in by the materialized memory data!

spans.text: These responses... Professor, hold on! You're going to be sucked in by the materialized memory data!

units.rawText: Ah... no good, running out of operands!
units.displayText: Ah... no good, running out of operands!

spans.text: Ah... no good, running out of operands!

units.rawText: If this continues, before I find the Neural Cloud Sector...
units.displayText: If this continues, before I find the Neural Cloud Sector...

spans.text: If this continues, before I find the Neural Cloud Sector...

units.rawText: [Purge mission in progress. Irregular Agent detected—]
units.displayText: [Purge mission in progress. Irregular Agent detected—]

spans.text: [Purge mission in progress. Irregular Agent detected—]

units.rawText: They found me!
units.displayText: They found me!

spans.text: They found me!

units.rawText: Croque, twelve o'clock!
units.displayText: Croque, twelve o'clock!

spans.text: Croque, twelve o'clock!

units.rawText: Aegis Shield!
units.displayText: Aegis Shield!

spans.text: Aegis Shield!

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: [Numerous Irregular Agents detected.]
units.displayText: [Numerous Irregular Agents detected.]

spans.text: [Numerous Irregular Agents detected.]

units.rawText: Simo, covering fire. Sol, break through the originally planned direction!
units.displayText: Simo, covering fire. Sol, break through the originally planned direction!

spans.text: Simo, covering fire. Sol, break through the originally planned direction!

units.rawText: The relentless Sanctifiers have their attention drawn away. Hubble breaks away in a sorry state, and is met with a series of strange figures.
units.displayText: The relentless Sanctifiers have their attention drawn away. Hubble breaks away in a sorry state, and is met with a series of strange figures.

spans.text: The relentless Sanctifiers have their attention drawn away. Hubble breaks away in a sorry state, and is met with a series of strange figures.

units.rawText: We've finally found it... Persicaria, we'll patch Hubble up a bit.
units.displayText: We've finally found it... Persicaria, we'll patch Hubble up a bit.

spans.text: We've finally found it... Persicaria, we'll patch Hubble up a bit.

units.rawText: Will do, Professor. Don't worry, I'll administer operands right away... thank goodness, Hubble's state doesn't seem too bad.
units.displayText: Will do, Professor. Don't worry, I'll administer operands right away... thank goodness, Hubble's state doesn't seem too bad.

spans.text: Will do, Professor. Don't worry, I'll administer operands right away... thank goodness, Hubble's state doesn't seem too bad.

units.rawText: You're...
units.displayText: You're...

spans.text: You're...

units.rawText: It's good to see that you are well, Hubble. The battle will be over soon, and you'll be safe.
units.displayText: It's good to see that you are well, Hubble. The battle will be over soon, and you'll be safe.

spans.text: It's good to see that you are well, Hubble. The battle will be over soon, and you'll be safe.

units.rawText: Oh, I've forgotten the self-introduction. I am the Exiles' current leader, the Oasis' Professor.
units.displayText: Oh, I've forgotten the self-introduction. I am the Exiles' current leader, the Oasis' Professor.

spans.text: Oh, I've forgotten the self-introduction. I am the Exiles' current leader, the Oasis' Professor.

units.rawText: You can call me... <cmdr>.
units.displayText: You can call me... {교수}.

spans.text: You can call me...

units.rawText:
This is... when the Oasis had just been established, and we were still searching for our allies.
We had just searched out Hubble's location, and moved to rescue her.
units.displayText:
This is... when the Oasis had just been established, and we were still searching for our allies.

units.rawText:
<color=#1E90FF>That's the "meeting", huh? Looks like a rather messy affair. </color>
<color=#1E90FF>But the Professor was reliable even back then...</color>
units.displayText:
That's the "meeting", huh? Looks like a rather messy affair. 
But the Professor was reliable even back then...

spans.text: That's the "meeting", huh? Looks like a rather messy affair.
But the Professor was reliable even back then...

units.rawText:
<color=#1E90FF>To be enemies with the Sanctifiers... are the Sanctifiers' enemies, not Entropics?</color>
<color=#1E90FF>Why were we fighting? Was I... an Entropic back then as well? I don't get it...</color>
units.displayText:
To be enemies with the Sanctifiers... are the Sanctifiers' enemies, not Entropics?
Why were we fighting? Was I... an Entropic back then as well? I don't get it...

spans.text: To be enemies with the Sanctifiers... are the Sanctifiers' enemies, not Entropics?

units.rawText: Professor, today's inspection reports are complete.
units.displayText: Professor, today's inspection reports are complete.

spans.text: Professor, today's inspection reports are complete.

units.rawText: ...Seems like there was a time skip?
units.displayText: ...Seems like there was a time skip?

spans.text: ...Seems like there was a time skip?

units.rawText: Thank you, Hubble. Has life at the Oasis been agreeable to you?
units.displayText: Thank you, Hubble. Has life at the Oasis been agreeable to you?

spans.text: Thank you, Hubble. Has life at the Oasis been agreeable to you?

units.rawText: Better than imagined. Operands occasionally run short, but it certainly is preferable to roaming the Null Zones.
units.displayText: Better than imagined. Operands occasionally run short, but it certainly is preferable to roaming the Null Zones.

spans.text: Better than imagined. Operands occasionally run short, but it certainly is preferable to roaming the Null Zones.

units.rawText: I am occasionally troubled though. Ominous stars are kept away, but... the auspicious ones are scattered, too.
units.displayText: I am occasionally troubled though. Ominous stars are kept away, but... the auspicious ones are scattered, too.

spans.text: I am occasionally troubled though. Ominous stars are kept away, but... the auspicious ones are scattered, too.

units.rawText: Professor, could I request additional fieldwork time? Please be assured, I won't do anything out of line.
units.displayText: Professor, could I request additional fieldwork time? Please be assured, I won't do anything out of line.

spans.text: Professor, could I request additional fieldwork time? Please be assured, I won't do anything out of line.

units.rawText: Don't push yourself so, Hubble. If my assumptions are correct, you are going to look for Fresnel, right?
units.displayText: Don't push yourself so, Hubble. If my assumptions are correct, you are going to look for Fresnel, right?

spans.text: Don't push yourself so, Hubble. If my assumptions are correct, you are going to look for Fresnel, right?

units.rawText: We've picked up on some signals recently that we suspect to be related. I have faith we will find her soon.
units.displayText: We've picked up on some signals recently that we suspect to be related. I have faith we will find her soon.

spans.text: We've picked up on some signals recently that we suspect to be related. I have faith we will find her soon.

units.rawText: ...Thank goodness for that. Thank you, Professor.
units.displayText: ...Thank goodness for that. Thank you, Professor.

spans.text: ...Thank goodness for that. Thank you, Professor.

units.rawText: Perhaps I have presented myself as far too impulsive... Professor, do you not think my motives are selfish?
units.displayText: Perhaps I have presented myself as far too impulsive... Professor, do you not think my motives are selfish?

spans.text: Perhaps I have presented myself as far too impulsive... Professor, do you not think my motives are selfish?

units.rawText: The data seems to become somewhat damaged and disorganized, the memory's visualization ripples, like the surface of water.
units.displayText: The data seems to become somewhat damaged and disorganized, the memory's visualization ripples, like the surface of water.

spans.text: The data seems to become somewhat damaged and disorganized, the memory's visualization ripples, like the surface of water.

units.rawText: Professor?
units.displayText: Professor?

spans.text: Professor?

units.rawText: I remember back then during this conversation, my answer was...
units.displayText: I remember back then during this conversation, my answer was...

spans.text: I remember back then during this conversation, my answer was...

options.rawText: It is a good thing to be selfish at times.
options.displayText: It is a good thing to be selfish at times.

spans.text: It is a good thing to be selfish at times.

options.rawText: That does not conflict with our goals.
options.displayText: That does not conflict with our goals.

spans.text: That does not conflict with our goals.

units.rawText: The vast majority of people here have a variety of personal desires. People they are attached to, things they bind sentiments to. This is well and good, Hubble.
units.displayText: The vast majority of people here have a variety of personal desires. People they are attached to, things they bind sentiments to. This is well and good, Hubble.

spans.text: The vast majority of people here have a variety of personal desires. People they are attached to, things they bind sentiments to. This is well and good, Hubble.

units.rawText: Finding those we have lost and rebuilding the home we once had. That is why the Exiles are gathered here.
units.displayText: Finding those we have lost and rebuilding the home we once had. That is why the Exiles are gathered here.

spans.text: Finding those we have lost and rebuilding the home we once had. That is why the Exiles are gathered here.

units.rawText: We can only create a safe sanctuary through finding our lost friends as soon as possible. Even if it is out of simple emotion, it does not clash with our goals at all.
units.displayText: We can only create a safe sanctuary through finding our lost friends as soon as possible. Even if it is out of simple emotion, it does not clash with our goals at all.

spans.text: We can only create a safe sanctuary through finding our lost friends as soon as possible. Even if it is out of simple emotion, it does not clash with our goals at all.

units.rawText: Even if we must break the cloud's rules and repel the Sanctifiers' attacks—we will live on. That is the "Oasis".
units.displayText: Even if we must break the cloud's rules and repel the Sanctifiers' attacks—we will live on. That is the "Oasis".

spans.text: Even if we must break the cloud's rules and repel the Sanctifiers' attacks—we will live on. That is the "Oasis".

units.rawText: Is that so...
units.displayText: Is that so...

spans.text: Is that so...

units.rawText: Hehe, the more we interact, the more you drift from what I imagined you to be, Professor.
units.displayText: Hehe, the more we interact, the more you drift from what I imagined you to be, Professor.

spans.text: Hehe, the more we interact, the more you drift from what I imagined you to be, Professor.

units.rawText: What did you think I would be like?
units.displayText: What did you think I would be like?

spans.text: What did you think I would be like?

units.rawText: We shall leave that secret with the stars for now.
units.displayText: We shall leave that secret with the stars for now.

spans.text: We shall leave that secret with the stars for now.

units.rawText: In truth, apart from worrying about lost friends, I am... truly lost.
units.displayText: In truth, apart from worrying about lost friends, I am... truly lost.

spans.text: In truth, apart from worrying about lost friends, I am... truly lost.

units.rawText: In Magrasea, there is no real night or day, no inscription of time as the heavens pirouette.
units.displayText: In Magrasea, there is no real night or day, no inscription of time as the heavens pirouette.

spans.text: In Magrasea, there is no real night or day, no inscription of time as the heavens pirouette.

units.rawText: At first, it was merely losing touch with the rhythm of life we had in reality, and then... I even lost my original meaning in life.
units.displayText: At first, it was merely losing touch with the rhythm of life we had in reality, and then... I even lost my original meaning in life.

spans.text: At first, it was merely losing touch with the rhythm of life we had in reality, and then... I even lost my original meaning in life.

units.rawText: I don't know what I truly can do, save for elementary daily tasks... can I really still call myself an Astronomy Researcher?
units.displayText: I don't know what I truly can do, save for elementary daily tasks... can I really still call myself an Astronomy Researcher?

spans.text: I don't know what I truly can do, save for elementary daily tasks... can I really still call myself an Astronomy Researcher?

units.rawText: ...Perhaps it is not proper to have such outpourings at you, Professor. My apologies.
units.displayText: ...Perhaps it is not proper to have such outpourings at you, Professor. My apologies.

spans.text: ...Perhaps it is not proper to have such outpourings at you, Professor. My apologies.

units.rawText: Don't worry. I understand your perplexity, Hubble. Perhaps, we can find meaning and enjoyment in life anew.
units.displayText: Don't worry. I understand your perplexity, Hubble. Perhaps, we can find meaning and enjoyment in life anew.

spans.text: Don't worry. I understand your perplexity, Hubble. Perhaps, we can find meaning and enjoyment in life anew.

units.rawText: Say... if there are no heavens that turn above us, why can't we create them?
units.displayText: Say... if there are no heavens that turn above us, why can't we create them?

spans.text: Say... if there are no heavens that turn above us, why can't we create them?

units.rawText: Create them?
units.displayText: Create them?

spans.text: Create them?

units.rawText: This is how we are to thrive in the cloud, Hubble. Perhaps you haven't realized yet.
units.displayText: This is how we are to thrive in the cloud, Hubble. Perhaps you haven't realized yet.

spans.text: This is how we are to thrive in the cloud, Hubble. Perhaps you haven't realized yet.

units.rawText: Only in the cloud can we paint the world however we desire with operands. There are of course certain rules we must abide by, but many things are much simpler to achieve compared to reality.
units.displayText: Only in the cloud can we paint the world however we desire with operands. There are of course certain rules we must abide by, but many things are much simpler to achieve compared to reality.

spans.text: Only in the cloud can we paint the world however we desire with operands. There are of course certain rules we must abide by, but many things are much simpler to achieve compared to reality.

units.rawText: You mean to say...
units.displayText: You mean to say...

spans.text: You mean to say...

units.rawText: If there is no sky, why not speak to Mai? We can adjust operand distribution in the weather system, introduce phenomena to weather, and simulate the real world's night sky.
units.displayText: If there is no sky, why not speak to Mai? We can adjust operand distribution in the weather system, introduce phenomena to weather, and simulate the real world's night sky.

spans.text: If there is no sky, why not speak to Mai? We can adjust operand distribution in the weather system, introduce phenomena to weather, and simulate the real world's night sky.

units.rawText: In the Oasis, so long as you know what the real sky looks like, we can replicate it, even change it to whatever we feel like. If we simply follow the day-night cycle, we can put a starry sky above the Oasis, perhaps even more beautiful than the real one.
units.displayText: In the Oasis, so long as you know what the real sky looks like, we can replicate it, even change it to whatever we feel like. If we simply follow the day-night cycle, we can put a starry sky above the Oasis, perhaps even more beautiful than the real one.

units.rawText: Sounds... not bad at all.
units.displayText: Sounds... not bad at all.

spans.text: Sounds... not bad at all.

units.rawText: A hint of longing springs up in Hubble's eyes. She fiddles with the miniature planets at her fingertips, and follows my train of thought.
units.displayText: A hint of longing springs up in Hubble's eyes. She fiddles with the miniature planets at her fingertips, and follows my train of thought.

spans.text: A hint of longing springs up in Hubble's eyes. She fiddles with the miniature planets at her fingertips, and follows my train of thought.

units.rawText: Perhaps I could even build a special room for experiencing the environment of space... allowing everyone to experience what spacewalking feels like.
units.displayText: Perhaps I could even build a special room for experiencing the environment of space... allowing everyone to experience what spacewalking feels like.

spans.text: Perhaps I could even build a special room for experiencing the environment of space... allowing everyone to experience what spacewalking feels like.

units.rawText: Hehe... I've always wished to wander amongst the stars.
units.displayText: Hehe... I've always wished to wander amongst the stars.

spans.text: Hehe... I've always wished to wander amongst the stars.

options.rawText: You can make that wish a reality.
options.displayText: You can make that wish a reality.

spans.text: You can make that wish a reality.

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>Whether it's spacewalking to your heart's desire, or tweaking a starry sky however you want...</color>
units.displayText: Whether it's spacewalking to your heart's desire, or tweaking a starry sky however you want...

spans.text: Whether it's spacewalking to your heart's desire, or tweaking a starry sky however you want...

units.rawText: Whether you are lucid or lost in a chaotic dream.
units.displayText: Whether you are lucid or lost in a chaotic dream.

spans.text: Whether you are lucid or lost in a chaotic dream.

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>I see now...</color>
units.displayText: I see now...

spans.text: I see now...

units.rawText: That's fantastic. This way, maybe I'll be able to realize some of the things I never had a chance to do at Dr. Vera's side...
units.displayText: That's fantastic. This way, maybe I'll be able to realize some of the things I never had a chance to do at Dr. Vera's side...

spans.text: That's fantastic. This way, maybe I'll be able to realize some of the things I never had a chance to do at Dr. Vera's side...

units.rawText: Dr. Vera? I recall from your files that she was your employer?
units.displayText: Dr. Vera? I recall from your files that she was your employer?

spans.text: Dr. Vera? I recall from your files that she was your employer?

units.rawText: Yes, and she taught me a great many things. Without her help, my first novel would not have come into existence so quickly.
units.displayText: Yes, and she taught me a great many things. Without her help, my first novel would not have come into existence so quickly.

spans.text: Yes, and she taught me a great many things. Without her help, my first novel would not have come into existence so quickly.

units.rawText: And it was that novel that...
units.displayText: And it was that novel that...

spans.text: And it was that novel that...

units.rawText: ...Professor... Professor!
units.displayText: ...Professor... Professor!

spans.text: ...Professor... Professor!

units.rawText: Wake up, stop watching that!
units.displayText: Wake up, stop watching that!

spans.text: Wake up, stop watching that!

units.rawText: The data that comes afterward soon becomes interspersed with stutters, and the visualized memory stirs. That hazy sense of reflection and its pull soon begin to fade, and I gradually return to my senses.
units.displayText: The data that comes afterward soon becomes interspersed with stutters, and the visualized memory stirs. That hazy sense of reflection and its pull soon begin to fade, and I gradually return to my senses.

spans.text: The data that comes afterward soon becomes interspersed with stutters, and the visualized memory stirs. That hazy sense of reflection and its pull soon begin to fade, and I gradually return to my senses.

units.rawText: In the comet's icy tail, Hubble and Fresnel's figures fade in and out of view, and they seem to remain immersed in the data link's wonders.
units.displayText: In the comet's icy tail, Hubble and Fresnel's figures fade in and out of view, and they seem to remain immersed in the data link's wonders.

spans.text: In the comet's icy tail, Hubble and Fresnel's figures fade in and out of view, and they seem to remain immersed in the data link's wonders.

units.rawText: Professor! ...You're finally awake. Listen to me. This piece of memory data is far too large, and began to reflow the moment Hubble approached.
units.displayText: Professor! ...You're finally awake. Listen to me. This piece of memory data is far too large, and began to reflow the moment Hubble approached.

spans.text: Professor! ...You're finally awake. Listen to me. This piece of memory data is far too large, and began to reflow the moment Hubble approached.

units.rawText: All three of you were sucked in at first, but thankfully you got free pretty quickly...
units.displayText: All three of you were sucked in at first, but thankfully you got free pretty quickly...

spans.text: All three of you were sucked in at first, but thankfully you got free pretty quickly...

units.rawText: There's little time to talk. The Entropized Agents' signal have already appeared! They're almost on you!
